name: Sentinel-2 Multispectral Satellite Earth Observation Catalog
description: Real-time optical multispectral satellite imagery metadata and preview tiles from ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 via AWS Earth Search STAC API for supply chain, port congestion, and crop monitoring.

etl.script: WITH features_raw AS (SELECT UNNEST(features) AS feat FROM read_json_auto('https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/collections/sentinel-2-l2a/items?limit=100')) SELECT CAST(feat.properties.datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS acquired_at, CAST(feat.id AS VARCHAR) AS scene_id, CAST(feat.properties."eo:cloud_cover" AS FLOAT) AS cloud_cover, CAST(feat.properties."grid:code" AS VARCHAR) AS grid_code, CAST(feat.assets.thumbnail.href AS VARCHAR) AS thumbnail_url FROM features_raw;
